explanation: Colour is no guide to age. Psycho came out in 1960, more than 20 years after Gone with the Wind, and Hitchcock made it in black and white partly to save money.

claims.text: Gone with the Wind, filmed in Technicolor, was released in 1939.
Psycho, filmed in black and white, was released in 1960.
Hitchcock made Psycho in black and white partly to keep its costs down.
Psycho came out more than 20 years after Gone with the Wind.
